thread:
maria (sec-eng): Heads up — noticed an RBAC regression in private deployments after yesterday's auth-policy roll. Need to confirm audit logging + KMS integration still working for our satellite VPCs. Anyone seeing failed audit writes?

sam (oncall): I saw alerts from ops: several 403s on /audit/entries coming from nodegroup-3 ~ 03:12 UTC. Investigating now. :eyes:

aj (infra): Which cluster is this? prod-private-nyc? I did push a tightened netpol last night (was meant to be conservative). Could be blocking the log-forwarder egress.

maria (sec-eng): Yes, prod-private-nyc. Important: we must not open 0.0.0.0/0. For private deployments we need explicit allowlists for collector IPs and KMS endpoints (or allow to local mTLS proxy). Also remember customers may use Vault/HSM instead of cloud KMS — need a robust fallback in policy.

sam (oncall): Logs show TLS handshake failures to kms.redwood-internal.example:502 and repeated "permission denied" from forwarder when writing audit entries. Short stack snippet: ```
Error: write failed: permission denied
at forwarder/shipper.go:142
CausedBy: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
```

aj (infra): Quick debug step: run `kubectl --context=prod-private-nyc -n redwood logs -l app=log-forwarder --tail=200` and check egress destinations. I'll do that now.

maria (sec-eng): Proposed netpol rule: allow egress to ipset {collector-ips, kms-ips, package-mirrors} on ports {443, 15001} and allow traffic to local sidecar/proxy socket. Also allow in-cluster unix socket to audit-agent. Keep the rule narrow and reference CIDR sets in a ConfigMap.

sam (oncall): For vuln triage: the auth-policy change was in PR #1823 which referenced CVE-20xx-zz. We rolled it without the feature flag; that change tightened ServiceAccount->NetworkPolicy mapping and inadvertently cut off forwarder egress. Options: rollback the PR or add a targeted exception for the log-forwarder service account.

aj (infra): I can patch the netpol to add the exception. Patch command I'll run: ```
kubectl patch networkpolicy allow-restricted-egress -n redwood --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/egress/-","value":{"to":[{"ipBlock":{"cidr":"10.24.16.0/24"}}],"ports":[{"protocol":"TCP","port":443}]}}]'
```

maria (sec-eng): Audit log guarantees: we must ensure logs go to an encrypted, append-only store. Implementation for private: produce signed audit bundles every 10 minutes, wrap with customer-managed KMS/HSM key (KMS wrap), and push to S3-compatible endpoint. For air-gapped installs provide an offline-signer workflow and an integrity manifest. This avoids relying on continuous egress to a central SaaS collector.

sam (oncall): From incident response POV: classify impact (write failures only, no data leakage). Recommend internal bulletin and a short customer-facing note only if SLAs impacted. I'll prepare timeline + detection windows and flag the severity.

devops-bot: Deployment roll started: 3034567905 - netpol-exception-patch by aj. Rolling to prod-private-nyc (3 nodes).

aj (infra): :thumbsup: Patch applied. log-forwarder can reach kms.redwood-internal.example and collector IPs now. Monitoring shows successing writes, no more TLS timeouts. Commit: 9f8c3b2. Commands used and brief diff attached in PR.

maria (sec-eng): Follow-ups (owners):
- Add infra CI tests that simulate restrictive netpols + allowed exceptions (owner: maria).
- Add RBAC integration test ensuring audit writes succeed with service account + KMS perms (owner: aj).
- Update private-deploy runbook with signed-bundle workflow + offline-signer steps (owner: maria).
- Draft incident blurb and schedule tabletop for private-deploy (owner: sam).

sam (oncall): I'll open the incident ticket and assign the postmortem. Also recommend we rotate test/staging keys after this.

maria (sec-eng): Also: update retention policy notes for private customers: 1y hot, 5y cold (enterprise). Ensure retention config is explicit in the install manifest.

rota-bot: Reminder: Incident on-call handover at 04:00 UTC.

maria (sec-eng): Thanks all. Closing loop once postmortem + runbook updates are in. :white_check_mark:
